description: Rule-based Shariah (Islamic finance) screen for US-listed companies, from each company's own filed financial statements: (1) a business-activity screen on the company's industry code (alcohol, tobacco, gambling, conventional banking and insurance, pork, weapons, adult; codes shared by permissible and impermissible businesses, such as hotels, are marked for review), (2) three ratio screens with the thresholds index Shariah methodologies use, applied to TOTAL ASSETS on the latest balance sheet: debt under 33%, cash and interest-bearing securities under 33%, receivables under 49%. Boards that divide by market capitalisation (as AAOIFI does) can reach a different verdict, and the 5% revenue test is not assessed. Returns a verdict (compliant / non_compliant / questionable) with each ratio, the balance-sheet date and the lines used. Per call.

ticker.description: US-listed ticker to screen, e.g. AAPL, XOM, JPM.

name: hsh-shariah-screen
